description.zh:
集合名。

> 可以通过[CreateCollection](~~2401497~~)创建，并通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)查看列表。

实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
命名空间，用于租户隔离，默认为public。

> 可以通过[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)创建，通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

>  You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace and call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.

The region ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The vector data that you want to upload.

description.zh:
此条向量数据的唯一ID。

> 如果为空，则由数据库uuidgen自动生成。如果不为空，且和数据库里已有的ID冲突，则会使用API的数据更新数据库里的值。
description.en:
The unique ID of the vector data.

>  If you leave this parameter empty, a unique ID is automatically generated by using uuidgen. If you specify a value that is the same as an existing ID, an updated vector data ID is used.

description.zh: 此条向量数据对应的元信息。其中key需和[CreateCollection](~~2401497~~)接口定义的Metadata的key一致。
description.en: The metadata of the vector data. The key field of this parameter must be the same as the key field of Metadata that is specified when you call the [CreateCollection](~~2401497~~) operation.

description.zh: 向量数据列表，长度和[CreateCollection](~~2401497~~)接口的维度一致。
description.en: The vector data. The length of the vector data must be the same as the value of Dimension that is specified when you call the [CreateCollection](~~2401497~~) operation.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect.
